title.narrative: Kenya Humanitanitarian Capacity Development project phase 2 April 2016 - March 2018

description.narrative: Phase 2 of the HCD project builds upon Phase 1 which was implemented from 2014 to March 2016. The HCD project aims to strengthen local organisations capacity to respond to emergencies in a more efficient and effective manner to meet the needs of most vulnerable groups and communities. The strategic Partners who will participate in this project are the old partners; Caritas Marsabit, Caritas Isiolo, Caritas Maralal and new partners; Caritas Mombasa, and Caritas Homabay. Humanitarian Capacity Development (HCD) process is not just one-off events, it uses wide range of approaches to develop capacities including; training, networking, coaching, mentoring, peer learning, exposure visits etc. By bringing these different approaches, HCD will sustain a process of individual and organisational change thereby enabling organisations to achieve their humanitarian goals. HCD addresses both human and institutional capacities. Institutional capacities remain in place as humans move on. HCD put emphasis on learning-by-doing experience because people learn best from real life experiences to acquire new abilities. In this project, a centralised training sessions will be facilitated. It includes trainings on Leadership & Management, fundraising training, Core Humanitarian Training, Emergency SimulationTraining. An exchange & learning visits between HCD partners and from other partners, Peer learning sessions, reflection and review meetings will be undertaken. Two Review meetings is planned to capture lessons and experiences. The main purpose of facilitating the activities will be to empower CAFOD strategic partners to deliver high quality and timely humanitarian assistance. This effort will enable vulnerable people in this areas to benefit from quality humanitarian response through capacity development.
